client_id.desc: Issued when you created your application. Must be the app the token being rotated was issued to. For each token, call the `oauth.v2.beginShortTokenRotation` method and pass the `token` you want to update, along with your `client_id` and `client_secret`. Pass the new replacement token as the `new_token` parameter, along with the same `client_id` and `client_secret`.

client_secret.desc: Issued when you created your application. For each token, call the `oauth.v2.beginShortTokenRotation` method and pass the `token` you want to update, along with your `client_id` and `client_secret`. Pass the new replacement token as the `new_token` parameter, along with the same `client_id` and `client_secret`.

new_token.desc: The new xoxp token returned by oauth.v2.beginShortTokenRotation. Pass the new replacement token as the `new_token` parameter, along with the same `client_id` and `client_secret`.

desc: Call this to finish rotating the secret on an old API token with a short secret. Must be paired with a call to oauth.v2.beginShortTokenRotation to start the process.

errors.invalid_client_id: Value passed for `client_id` was invalid, or is not the app the token being rotated was issued to.
errors.rotation_not_found: No pending rotation was found for this token. Call oauth.v2.beginShortTokenRotation first, or the pending rotation may have expired.
errors.token_too_long: This token is not short enough to be rotated.
